props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: When a change is final: on blur after typing, on each key, wheel turn and stepper click, and on release after holding a stepper or scrubbing.

props.name: step
props.description: Arrow keys and the steppers. Default 1.

props.name: snapOnStep
props.description: Snap a step to a multiple of the step from `min` (or 0).

props.name: allowOutOfRange
props.description: Let typed values outside [min, max] stand (steps still clamp); the field is then invalid, natively.

props.name: allowWheelScrub
props.description: Turn the wheel over the focused input to step.

props.name: name
props.description: With a name (or inside a named FieldRoot), a hidden number input submits the value with the form.

props.name: format
props.description: How the value is shown, and how typed text is read.

parts.name: NumberFieldGroup
parts.description: Groups the input and the steppers.

parts.name: NumberFieldInput
parts.description: The text input. Arrow Up/Down step (Shift: large step, Alt: small step), Home/End go to min/max when set, the wheel steps while focused (with `allowWheelScrub`), and blur parses, clamps and formats what was typed.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field's value has changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field has a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is valid.

parts.name: NumberFieldIncrement
parts.description: A stepper button: click to step once, hold to repeat. Disabled at its bound. Not in the tab order (the input steps with the arrow keys), but not hidden from touch screen readers.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

parts.name: NumberFieldDecrement
parts.description: A stepper button: click to step once, hold to repeat. Disabled at its bound. Not in the tab order (the input steps with the arrow keys), but not hidden from touch screen readers.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the part is disabled.

parts.name: NumberFieldScrubArea
parts.description: Press and drag to change the value: right (or up, vertically) increases it. The pointer is locked while scrubbing; NumberFieldScrubAreaCursor is the cursor shown instead.

props.name: direction
props.description: The axis the pointer moves along to scrub. Default "horizontal".

props.name: pixelSensitivity
props.description: Px of movement per step. Default 2.

props.name: teleportDistance
props.description: How far, in px, the virtual cursor may go from the area before it wraps to the other side.

parts.name: NumberFieldScrubAreaCursor
parts.description: The cursor shown while scrubbing with a mouse (the real one is locked and hidden), rendered into the body and positioned where the virtual pointer is. Give it a size and an icon.
